queries.query: What are the eligibility requirements a film must meet to be considered an animated feature at the Oscars?
queries.expected_answer: An animated feature must run more than 40 minutes, have characters' performances created using a frame-by-frame technique, feature a significant number of animated major characters, and consist of at least 75 percent animation of its running time. Motion capture by itself does not count as an animation technique.

supporting_quotes.text: An animated feature is defined by the academy as a film with a running time of more than 40 minutes in which characters' performances are created using a frame-by-frame technique, a significant number of the major characters are animated, and animation figures in no less than 75 percent of the running time.
Motion capture by itself is not an animation technique.

queries.difficulty_notes: Note the 40-minute threshold in the category article versus the 70-minute figure quoted from 2002 in the ceremony article — a system must not conflate the two.
required_aspects: An animated feature must run more than 40 minutes, have characters' performances created using a frame-by-frame technique, feature a significant number of animated major characters, and consist of at least 75 percent animation of its running time.
Motion capture by itself does not count as an animation technique.
